android-forms|OutlinedTextField.summary: A Plenix text field on Android is the Material 3 outlined text field, kept native in behavior (the label that floats into the outline, the keyboard type, autofill, the cursor and selection handles, TalkBack reading the label, helper and error, font scale) and styled with the Plenix tokens: a white container at least 56 dp tall with a 6 dp radius and a 1 dp border, DM Sans text at the body text role and the Plenix field colors. Focus and an error change only the border color, never its width. Material’s default has a 4 dp radius and a border that thickens to 2 dp in the primary color on focus; Plenix keeps Material’s structure and replaces the look.

anatomy.name: Supporting text

anatomy.name: Trailing icon

android-forms|Switch.summary: A Plenix switch on Android is the Material 3 Switch in a full-width row, kept native in behavior (the whole row toggles, the thumb slides and grows on press, TalkBack reads it as a switch with its label and state, font scale) and styled with the Plenix tokens: the action color for on, the Plenix gray track for off, a white thumb with no icon, and the label in DM Sans at the body text role at the start of a 48 dp row. Material’s default draws an outlined off track with a small dark thumb in the theme colors; Plenix keeps Material’s sizes and structure and replaces the colors and type. A switch takes effect at once; a choice saved later with a button is a checkbox.

android-forms|Checkbox.summary: A Plenix checkbox on Android is the Material 3 Checkbox in a full-width row, kept native in behavior (the whole row toggles, the check animates, TalkBack reads it as a checkbox with its label and state, including the mixed state, font scale) and styled with the Plenix tokens: the action color for checked and mixed boxes, a strong gray outline for empty ones, and the label in DM Sans at the body text role in a 48 dp row, with an optional description below. android-forms|Radio group.summary: A Plenix radio group on Android is a column of Material 3 RadioButton rows in a selectable group, kept native in behavior (each whole row selects its option, TalkBack reads the option, its state and its position in the group, keyboard and D-pad move between options, font scale) and styled with the Plenix tokens: the action color for the selected circle, a strong gray outline for the others, a legend over the group and labels in DM Sans at the body text role in 48 dp rows. Material’s default uses the theme’s primary and on-surface variant colors with Roboto labels; Plenix keeps Material’s circle, sizes and structure and replaces the colors and type. Use a radio group for two to about six options where one must be chosen; longer lists use an exposed dropdown menu.

android-forms|Slider.summary: A Plenix slider on Android is the Material 3 Slider, kept native in behavior (dragging or tapping the track, steps that snap, TalkBack reading the value and adjusting it with swipes, keyboard and D-pad arrows) and styled with the Plenix tokens: the action color for the handle and the filled track, the Plenix gray for the rest, and a label with the current value above the track in DM Sans. Material’s default uses the theme’s primary and secondary container colors and shows the value only in a bubble while dragging; Plenix keeps Material’s sizes and structure and replaces the colors and type. The change is recorded when the person lets go.
